nodes.label: Transactional JSON Store Invariant
nodes.rationale: Persist candidate state before publishing it in memory so a failed disk write cannot create memory/disk divergence.

nodes.label: Reproducible Dependency Lock Invariant
nodes.rationale: Human-edited direct pins and generated transitive locks reduce environment drift and agent repair cost.

nodes.label: Transactional JSON Persistence
nodes.rationale: A store commit writes and fsyncs candidate state before publishing it to readers.

nodes.label: Fail-fast Durable Store Startup
nodes.rationale: A corrupted durable store stops startup after backup instead of being treated as empty and overwritten later.

nodes.label: Scheduler Processing Checkpoint
nodes.rationale: A process-local checkpoint prevents duplicate delivery or empty CalDAV polling when marker persistence fails.

nodes.label: Bounded Telegram Update Backpressure
nodes.rationale: Polling pauses when running plus queued work reaches twice the worker count, bounding memory without acknowledging unfinished updates.

nodes.label: Best-effort Bot Shutdown
nodes.rationale: Each resource closer runs independently so one cleanup failure cannot leak all later resources.

nodes.label: Corrupt Store Recovery Procedure
nodes.rationale: Restore a validated backup after a CRITICAL fail-fast startup; the newest snapshot may itself contain the corrupted file.

nodes.label: UV Generated Lock Contract
nodes.rationale: All direct and transitive versions are generated by one pinned uv release and verified without mutating locks.

nodes.label: Targeted Mypy Strict Mode
nodes.rationale: Strict checks protect persistence and lifecycle code without forcing a risky global annotation rewrite.

nodes.label: Architectural Hardening Regression Matrix
nodes.rationale: Release-blocking tests explicitly protect transactional rollback, fail-fast loading, scheduler checkpoints, best-effort shutdown, and bounded update dispatch.
